zh.title: 三起航空事件彙整：Jet2跑道偏出、Hong Kong行動電源熱失控、United起落架不安全
zh.summary: 三起獨立事件：Jet2跑道偏出；Hong Kong行動電源熱失控；United起落架不安全
body: The Aviation Herald彙整三起彼此獨立的航空事件，三則標題所列日期均為2026年10月25日。以下事件涉及不同航空器與狀況，資料未指出彼此有關。
1. Jet2一架波音737-800（ICAO機型代碼B738）於伯明罕發生短暫跑道偏出事件，日期為2026年10月25日。
2. Hong Kong一架空中巴士A321neo（ICAO機型代碼A21N）在航程中於2026年10月25日發生行動電源熱失控事件。
3. United一架波音737 MAX 9（ICAO機型代碼B39M）於休士頓在2026年10月25日發生起落架不安全狀況。

en.title: Three-event aviation safety roundup: Jet2, Hong Kong and United incidents
en.summary: Three independent events: Jet2 runway excursion; Hong Kong power-bank thermal runaway; United unsafe gear.
body: The Aviation Herald's roundup covers three independent aviation events, each dated October 25, 2026. The items concern different aircraft and occurrences, and no relationship between them is stated.
1. The Jet2 item describes a temporary runway excursion at Birmingham involving a Boeing 737-800 (ICAO type code B738) on October 25, 2026.
2. The Hong Kong item concerns an Airbus A321neo (ICAO type code A21N) en route, where a power bank experienced thermal runaway on October 25, 2026.
3. The United item describes unsafe gear involving a Boeing 737 MAX 9 (ICAO type code B39M) at Houston on October 25, 2026.
